member.name: T:SysWeaver.AI.AiPromptMinimizer
member.summary:
Rule based minimizer of English LLM prompts, see .
Works in three steps: 1. Everything that must survive verbatim (code, quotes, templates, tags, identifiers, urls, examples..) is swapped for an opaque slot. 2. The remaining prose is rewritten by a set of rules, that are all written to fail safe, when in doubt the text is left as is. 3. The slots are swapped back.
Things that are deliberately never removed, since doing so can change what the LLM is told to do: - Negations and exceptions (not, never, no, without, except, unless..). - Modals and conditions (must, should, may, only, always, if, when..). - Words that restrict or are manner of a command (just, only, very, clearly, simply at the end of a sentence, literally, honestly..). - UPPERCASE words (emphasis).
Rewrites target tokens rather than chars, so abbreviations (e.g. "for example" to "e.g.") and vowel dropping is not used, as they usually tokenize worse. This is a separate class so that the compiled regular expressions aren't created until they are needed.
